svg.title: THE HOLE THE CD CAME OUT OF

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: THE HOLE THE CD CAME OUT OF

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A CD slot is 125 mm wide because a CD is 120 mm. The deck's window needs 84. That is the whole idea.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 1 · AS YOU FIND IT

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a fixed-face CD unit: a small display window, and the slot

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: its window 52 × 18

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: the slot ~125 × 12

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠️ Its own display window is 52 × 18 mm.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 256×64 panel needs 84 × 27, so you are

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cutting a new aperture whichever way you

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: go — the slot is not in the way of that.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It is the thing that makes it easy.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2 · THE COINCIDENCE, TO SCALE

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the window the deck wants, laid over the slot you already have

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 84 × 27 window

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 125 mm of width you already have — 41 mm more than you need

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The slot is ALREADY 41 mm wider than the

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: window needs to be. What it is short of is

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: height: 12 mm against 27.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: So file 7.5 mm off the top edge and 7.5 off

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom. One axis, one file, following

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two straight edges that are already there.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cutting a fresh 84 × 27 rectangle into a

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thirty-year-old fascia is the job people

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: abandon the build over.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 3 · OR, IF YOU WOULD RATHER NOT CUT IT

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the slot takes buttons or sockets with no drilling at all

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 125 × 12 mm aperture is a ready-made

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: button strip: six caps at roughly 20 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pitch, straight into a hole that is already

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the right shape.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Or put the aux and USB sockets through it.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Either way there is no hole saw anywhere

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: near the one part you cannot replace.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: AND ONE DONOR WHOSE DISPLAY SIZE IS PUBLISHED

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Pioneer MEH-P9000R's own screen is 256 × 52 pixels — a figure Pioneer printed. At the usual 0.3 mm pitch that is a 76.8 × 15.6 mm

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lit area. The deck's SSD1322 is 256 × 64, which is 76.8 × 19.2 — THE SAME WIDTH, and 3.6 mm taller.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: So that one window is already the right width and wants opening by about 4 mm. Every other donor: measure it — tools/donors/fit.py.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠️ Slot sizes are typical, not measured — a CD is 120 mm so the width is near enough fixed, but the height varies 10–14 mm by model. Measure yours before filing anything.
